## Verification

List focused tests and the full checks run. Include useful output, not credentials or private data.

- [ ] `pnpm schema:check`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm audit --prod`

## Review notes

Call out migrations, intentional limitations and areas that need especially careful review.
